Initial release of Free Video Generation Online skill.

- Instantly generate ready-to-share 1080p videos from text prompts or images—no editing software required.
- Supports JPG, PNG, MP4, MOV files up to 200MB for upload.
- Automatic connection setup: obtains a token and session with 100 free credits (7-day expiry).
- Exports deliver MP4 files in 1–2 minutes via cloud GPU rendering.
- Handles common video creation actions through natural language prompts (generate, export, upload, check credits, etc.).
- Includes robust error handling for tokens, file limits, and rate limits.
